method: Every changed portable SVG rendered with headless Chrome at 760px and 320px (2× density) and compared with its previous 760px export; three read-only reviewer agents inspected 18 figures each against captions and nearby text; /root re-inspected all flagged figures at both widths after fixes, plus spot checks of the native reader in light and dark themes.
